properties.evidence: Delivers api-boss's own fix (3) — "let a Decision CLOSE a Question with an edge, making the linkage first-class and surviving whichever id scheme wins". MITIGATES rather than INVALIDATES on purpose: their PRIMARY defect is untouched. `answer_question` still derives the question id by pure string manipulation from the gap id, so a Question stored under any other id remains unreachable by that tool. What this closes is the LINKAGE half they named as durable-but-unmodelled; the id scheme half is still open.
